results.name: under an assumed X25519 break the classical capture opens and the hybrid capture stays closed
results.detail: The X25519 half was recovered but the session key also depends on the ML-KEM-768 secret, which the adversary does not have. The AES-GCM authentication check fails, so the recording stays closed.
